hints: The order is decided in the client: `sortBooks` in `client/src/collection.ts`. Daniel noticed that the covers already file The Giver under G; look at what the covers use (`client/src/components/BookCover.tsx`) and what `sortBooks` uses.

`collection.ts` has `filingTitle(title)`, which takes a leading "The", "A" or "An" (followed by a space) off a title. The covers use it, the author and newest orders use it to break ties, and the **title** order compares `a.title` with `b.title` as they are.

Compare the filing titles: `collator.compare(filingTitle(a.title), filingTitle(b.title))`. The regular expression of `filingTitle` already requires a space after the article, so "Theo" and "Anatomy" stay as they are, and the card still shows the full title.
